people.imagined: The pearl scales at the Nguyệt Tân market. She holds a pearl up to the light and looks at the buyer, not the pearl, through her shell spectacles, deciding who is lying. The north beds pay in round numbers and it bothers her.
people.subject: The moment: at a market counter in the early light she holds a single white pearl up in long bone tweezers between the viewer and the window, looking at the viewer rather than the pearl, deciding who is lying. Face: most important, the spectacles: round lenses of polished, thin, iridescent pearl-shell in fine silver wire frames, shimmering pink-green, big and clear. A square, tanned, steady face of about forty, a wide forehead, level dark brown eyes seen pearly and magnified through the shell lenses, plain straight brows, a short nose, a calm closed mouth with the corners just down, a fisher's sun lines at the eyes. Hair: black with grey threads, in a tight low bun held by a pearl-headed silver pin. Body: broad-shouldered, still and upright behind the counter. Clothing: graceful layered robes of moon-white silk with evening-blue crossed collars, a pearl-grey gauze over-robe with wide sleeves, the collars and cuffs embroidered in silver thread with small fish and moon ripples, a lake-blue sash tied at the front, a short grey sealskin shawl over her shoulders as a steward's one plain thing, and a string of small round pearls at her wrist. Hands and objects: the tweezers hold a pea-sized pearl aloft; on the counter before her a small brass balance with two tiny pans. Power: a faint blue-white sheen of water qi lies on the pearl and a few tiny droplets of light hang about her hands. Background: a blurred market stall of shell bowls and a window of white lake mist. Light: soft cool lake light from the upper left, the pearl glinting like a small moon. Expression: a level, unhurried look that weighs the viewer as it would a pearl.

people.imagined: Night at the pool edge. He has just filled the shell lamp, and the glow shows his bare brow ridges, since the eyebrows never grew back. He is devout and slow, and he watches a fry in the dark water to decide whether it may be fed.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the edge of a dark pool at night, he looks up from the black water with a pale shell lamp beside him, the glow lighting his face from below. Face: most important, the missing eyebrows: the skin above both eyes is bare, smooth and pink-pale with only a few short thin stubble hairs, giving his face a startled, bare look. A long, narrow, pale face of about thirty with sharp cheekbones, large wide-set dark eyes that seem larger for the bare brow, a long thin nose, a thin solemn mouth, a small scar on the chin. Hair: black, in a neat short tail at the nape, tied with a pale blue cord. Body: thin, long-limbed, hunched low. Clothing: the sleeves of his moon-white silk robe tied back with blue cord for work, a pearl-grey gauze over-robe trailing into the water at its hem, evening-blue crossed collars embroidered with tiny silver fish, an evening-blue sash and one small pearl-shell button at the throat; his feet are bare on the dark wet planks. Hands and objects: in his right hand a little oyster-shell lamp ground paper-thin, glowing a milky white, held low; his left hand trails in the water with fingers apart. Power: pale blue water qi curls up from his fingertips like thin smoke, and a ring of silver ripples spreads from them. Background: a still black pool, small silver fish shapes just under the surface, a faint round reflection like a second moon. Light: the milky glow of the shell lamp from the lower right across his bare brow, a faint blue night at the left. Expression: devout, solemn, reserved.

people.imagined: The shore at Tuyết Lộc. He holds a piece of reindeer horn up to a pair of pilgrims and swears it is spirit-fish bone, and his hat gives a ridiculous dignity to the lie.
people.subject: The moment: on a snowy lakeshore at midday he holds a curved piece of pale antler up to the viewer with a grin as wide as his face, as if offering a rare treasure. Face: most important, the hat: a tall furred hat of brown-and-white reindeer hide with floppy ear flaps tied under the chin, one flap sticking out sideways, filling the top of the frame. A round, cheerful, wind-reddened boy's face of sixteen, narrow dark eyes full of nerve, thin light brows lifted, a snub nose with a drip, a big gap-toothed grin. Hair: a black fringe sticking out beneath the hat. Body: small and wiry, shoulders puffed up with boast. Clothing: the plain, tidy robes of an outer diver: close-fitting sea-grey silk with narrow sleeves and a crossed collar edged in pale blue, a short pearl-grey gauze jacket over it, a blue sash tied twice around, thick reindeer-fur mittens hanging on a cord at his neck and white fur boots; one small pearl-shell button is his only ornament. Hands and objects: a forked, pale yellow-white reindeer horn held aloft in his right hand; his left hand open, palm up, for a coin. Power: none to speak of, only a few glittering motes of frost-blue water qi in the cold air about his sleeve. Background: a snow shore and a grey frozen lake edge, a dark herd of reindeer small and blurred, a thin silver mist. Light: cold white winter light from the upper left, a soft pearl rim along the fur. Expression: gleeful, cheeky, a liar's confidence.

people.imagined: The market in the early morning. Her basket, which smells of brine at all hours, carries something under a damp cloth; she sets it down very gently and keeps one hand on the lid.
people.subject: The moment: in the early market she sets a wide wicker basket down on a stone and rests her hand on its damp cloth lid, glancing sideways. Face: most important, the basket: a big round basket of pale wicker with a wet green-grey cloth over its top, beads of water dripping from it, filling the lower half of the frame, with a faint damp shine. A neat, round, pretty face of twenty-two, smooth pale skin, careful dark eyes, thin straight brows, a small nose, a small tight mouth. Hair: black, in two neat buns at the sides of the head tied with blue ribbon, with a small pearl-shell comb. Body: slim, shoulders drawn in, upright and careful, her feet close together and her free elbow tucked in. Clothing: an inner disciple's flowing robe of moon-white silk with crossed evening-blue collars and narrow sleeves, a short pearl-grey gauze over-robe, the collar and cuffs embroidered with small silver fish and ripples, an evening-blue sash, a short grey sealskin cape fastened with a shell button, a string of tiny pearl beads at the neck. Hands and objects: her right hand pressed flat on the basket's cloth; her left holds the handle, wrapped in blue cord, her knuckles white around it. Power: a faint blue sheen of water qi gathers about the damp basket and a few bright droplets float up from the cloth. Background: stone market stalls softly blurred, wet cobbles, a drifting pearl-pink mist. Light: soft pink-white dawn light from the upper left, a pearly rim along her cheek. Expression: a careful, small, closed look with the eyes cast sideways, the watchfulness of a girl hiding something under a wet cloth.

people.imagined: The pool at dusk. She leans at the rail and murmurs, under her breath, the dead names of the fish as they come to the surface, one by one, her grandmother's name last of all.
people.subject: The moment: leaning over a wooden rail by a dark pool at dusk, her lips moving softly as she looks down at silver shapes rising in the water. Face: most important, the downward gaze and moving lips: her eyes fixed on the water with tender attention, mouth half-open on a whispered name. A soft, round, pale face of nineteen with a rounded chin, large gentle dark eyes, thin straight brows, a small nose with fine freckles across it, a line of fine dark lashes shadowing each cheek. Hair: black and long, in a single thick braid over the shoulder tied with an evening-blue ribbon, a small shell clip. Body: small, shoulders sloped, leaning on her forearms. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of moon-white silk with crossed evening-blue collars, wide sleeves of pearl-grey gauze whose cuffs are wet at the edges, embroidered with small silver fish and moon ripples, an evening-blue sash, a pale grey sealskin shawl, a pearl-shell hairpin; her feet are bare on the planks. Hands and objects: her right hand holds a small paper-thin shell bowl of fish-feed; the left trails fingertips just above the water where a few grains float. Power: soft blue water qi shimmers on the pool as if the fish were answering her, and tiny pearl-white motes rise from each ripple. Background: dark water with a dozen small silver glints of fish, a reflected pale disc like a moon. Light: a soft pearly glow rising from the water onto her face, deep dusk blue above. Expression: tender and dogged, lips parting on a whispered name and the lashes lowered.

people.imagined: The shallows at night, a boat of oysters. He sits on the gunwale drumming his heels, grinning, because it is a game. He cannot be still and he nearly tells the whole story every time someone asks.
people.subject: The moment: perched on the gunwale of a small boat at night he drums his heels, grinning at the viewer with a forefinger half-raised to his lips as though about to share a secret. Face: most important, the grin with the raised finger: his lips parted in a conspirator's grin, the other hand a blur drumming on the wood. A narrow, quick, boyish face of seventeen with a pointed chin, large bright brown eyes with a gleam, thin quick brows, a short nose, a big gap-toothed grin, a smear of grey mud on one cheek. Hair: tousled sandy-brown hair with a cowlick. Body: wiry, slouching, restless. Clothing: the close-fitting sea-grey silk of an outer diver, a loose pearl-grey gauze jacket hanging open over a bare chest, embroidered at the hem with small silver ripples, trousers of the same sea-grey rolled to the knee, an evening-blue sash tied in a loose bow, a cord of tiny pearl shells round the ankle. Hands and objects: the raised forefinger; behind him on the thwart a heap of grey oysters in a net, a few showing tiny pale seams of nacre. Power: a thin blue shimmer of water qi runs along the wet gunwale and a few pearl-white motes drift up from the oysters as if they were laughing too. Background: a black, still shallow with a dark shore, a faint moon-glow on a pale rim of water. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left, blue-silver, a soft rim along his hair. Expression: a playful, careless, generous grin with a secret nearly out, the eyes bright and the lips parted around the gap in his teeth.

people.imagined: The dock after a dive. She is sure she is first and tells everyone her breath-hold, unasked, one hand on her great ribcage. The memory of a cut air-line makes her grin.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the dock just after surfacing, chest out and chin up, she announces herself to the viewer. Face: most important, the barrel chest and the chin: a very deep, wide ribcage swelling her close silk jacket, shoulders thrown back, the chin lifted. A broad, round, sunburnt face of eighteen with a wide jaw, hard bright hazel eyes, thick dark brows, a short nose, a smug tight smile, wet strands on her cheek; water drips from her chin and the tip of her nose is red. Hair: black, wet and slicked back, a thick braid tied on top with grey cord. Body: powerful, short and thick through the chest, thick shoulders, ribs rising visibly with each deep breath. Clothing: the close-fitting sea-grey silk of a diver, soaked and clinging, a cropped pearl-grey gauze jacket with silver ripple embroidery at the edges, an evening-blue sash tied tight, a short sealskin skirt, bare shoulders; a pearl-shell nose clip hangs round her neck on a cord. Hands and objects: one hand thumping her own chest; the other holds a coil of air-line, a hose of waxed sea-silk, looped over the forearm. Power: a deep blue breath of water qi swells faintly around her ribs, and drops from her hair hang in the air like beads of light. Background: wet planks, a pale grey lake and a white sky. Light: bright pale light from the upper left, water glitter along her shoulders. Expression: a boastful, tight, smug smile with a hard glint in the hazel eyes and a flash of cruelty beneath it, an impatient girl who is sure she is first.

people.imagined: The manor's high seat, a day of pearls. She laughs before she says no, and the laugh shakes the two large pearls in her ears. She is wearing what she likes, which is a pale and costly robe.
people.subject: The moment: seated broad and easy in a high carved chair, she laughs warmly with her head tipped back a little, before delivering a refusal. Face: most important, the earrings: one large round pearl in each ear, the size of a quail's egg, creamy white with a pink-green sheen, hanging from fine gold hooks, large and clear. A broad, handsome, strong-jawed face of about fifty, a high smooth pale-gold forehead with fine laugh lines, dark warm shrewd eyes crinkled up, arched brows, a full mouth in a wide laugh, a dimple. Hair: black with a faint silver-white frost at the temples, swept up in a high heavy coil under a small crown of seed pearls, held with a long pearl-headed pin. Body: broad, deep-chested, a diver's shoulders, relaxed. Clothing: as mistress of her manor she wears what she likes, and wears it richly: layered robes of pale lake silk in pearl-white with a deep crossed collar, a translucent pearl-grey gauze over-robe with trailing sleeves, hems and cuffs embroidered with silver fish and moon ripples that shimmer like nacre, an evening-blue brocade sash, a thick necklace of small grey pearls. Hands and objects: a fist-sized pearl resting on a small jade stand at her elbow; one broad hand open on the chair arm. Power: a deep, cold blue-white mist of water qi spreads slowly from the great pearl across her lap, with a faint breath of frost at its edge, and tiny moon-pale motes rise from her shoulders. Background: a high hall of pale wooden pillars and a distant lake window. Light: soft pearly light from the upper left, warm gold below. Expression: warm, shrewd and amused.

people.imagined: The pool on a dark night, the false moon lit. His wet hands hold the shell lantern and the fish drift up in a slow ring under it. He smells of the pool and does not mind.
people.subject: The moment: stooped over a dark pool on a dark night, he lifts a large glowing shell lantern before him, water running from his hands, and the false moon is lit. Face: most important, the wet hands and the lantern: both hands dripping and wrinkled like boiled cloth, clasping a lantern of oyster-shell ground thin as paper, glowing a soft milky white like a full moon, big in the frame. A thin, stooped, long face of sixty-six, sunken cheeks, kind tired pale-grey eyes, thin white brows, a long thin nose, a gentle loose mouth, wet beads on the chin; water-weed clings to one brow. Hair: thin white hair in a loose bun held by a silver pin and a twist of water-weed. Body: thin, bent forward, narrow shoulders. Clothing: as an elder of the manor he wears the finer silks, but they are soaked: moon-white robes dark with water at the sleeves and hem, a pearl-grey gauze over-robe floating on the pool's surface, collars embroidered with silver fish and moon ripples, an evening-blue sash gone nearly grey, a small crown of pearl-shell at the knot of his hair, a short grey sealskin cape. Hands and objects: a small wet dip-net coiled at his belt and a fish-bone comb pinned at his collar. Power: a deep blue-white shimmer of water qi gathers about the lantern like a second moon, and a slow ring of silver fish rises toward it through glowing ripples. Background: a black pool, a low timber walkway on piles beside him, the far bank lost in dark mist. Light: the milky-white lantern glow from below on his face, deep blue night above. Expression: a devoted, gentle weariness, the soft eyes fixed on the rising fish.

people.imagined: A late night over the ledgers in the shore house. Her fingers are black with ink from the steward's books and she has chosen not to wash them. She was named for a frost that never came.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk in a lamplit room late at night she looks up from a book of accounts with ink-stained hands resting on its edge. Face: most important, the ink-stained fingers: all ten fingertips and both palms stained deep blue-black with ink, held in the lamplight in the foreground. A tall woman's long, even face of about thirty-six, clear pale skin without a trace of the manor's frost, level dark patient eyes, straight well-defined brows, a straight nose, a closed composed mouth, a faint line between the brows, fine shadows under her eyes from late nights. Hair: plain black, parted in the middle and wound into a low knot with a pale jade pin; no other ornament. Body: tall, upright, long neck, sitting very straight with the book squared before her. Clothing: as chosen heir she wears the sect's richer dress with restraint: layered moon-white silk with evening-blue crossed collars, a pearl-grey gauze over-robe, sleeves pushed back past the wrists, silver fish and moon ripples embroidered along the collar, an evening-blue brocade sash, a grey sealskin shawl; no pearls at all. Hands and objects: ink-stained hands flat on an open book of blank pages; a brush laid across it, a small black ink-stone. Power: a thin, cool blue breath of water qi lies over her shoulders like mist on a lake, and a single pearl-white mote drifts in the lamplight. Background: a lamplit shore-house office, shelves of bound books, a dark window with a pearl of moon. Light: warm yellow lamp from the lower right, cool lake light from the upper left. Expression: a steady, composed look with the mouth closed and the slightest ambition in the set of the jaw.

people.imagined: The shore house counting-room. He has two brushes behind one ear and the abacus of pearl beads under his thumb; his two ledgers lie side by side, and he smiles at the visitor, giving nothing.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table in the counting-room he smiles politely at a visitor, his thumb resting on an abacus, giving nothing. Face: most important, the abacus of pearl beads and the two brushes: a small abacus whose beads are real round white pearls strung on thin gold rods, big in the foreground, and two thin ink brushes tucked behind his right ear, one over the other. A small, neat, round-faced man of about thirty-nine with a smooth pink-brown complexion, narrow bright careful eyes, thin arched brows, a small straight nose, a small mouth with a polite curve, a thin moustache and a point of beard. Hair: black, oiled and neat in a small topknot with a pale blue band and a silver pin. Body: small, plump, straight in his chair. Clothing: a steward's robes of moon-white silk with crossed evening-blue collars and a pale-blue cuff band, a pearl-grey gauze over-robe with wide neat sleeves, silver fish and moon ripples embroidered at the hem, an evening-blue sash tied in an exact bow, a grey sealskin waistcoat, a small jade ring on his little finger. Hands and objects: the abacus; behind it two closed bound books side by side. Power: a faint blue sheen of water qi in the pearls, with a pale earth-yellow trace running through them like gold dust. Background: a tidy office of shelves of pearl jars and a window of lake light. Light: even soft white light from the upper left, a gentle shine on the pearls. Expression: polite and guarded, the smile exactly as wide as courtesy requires.

people.imagined: A hot noon on the pearl-bed dock, his shirt off after a dive, a drinking bowl in hand, which Mục Tiềm Uyên has told him not to do. The scar around his ribs shows. He has fished out a boy who did not come up.
people.subject: The moment: bare-chested on a wooden dock after a long dive, water streaming off him, he lifts a drinking bowl and grins. Face: most important, the scar: a thick rope of white scar line runs round his ribs from the back and across the front of his chest, a ridged pale cord clear against tanned skin. A rugged, square, sun-dark face of thirty-three, heavy brows, narrow green-grey eyes with a lazy callous gleam, a broken nose, a wide easy dangerous grin, a short stubble; water runs from his hair into his stubble and over the scar-ridged chest. Hair: black, wet, tied in a short tail with a cord. Body: broad, tall, heavily muscled across the shoulders, still dripping. Clothing: a chief diver's dress: his pearl-grey gauze over-robe thrown open and falling off the shoulders, sea-grey silk trousers soaked and clinging, an evening-blue silk cloth tied round the right bicep embroidered with a silver ripple, a belt of grey sealskin with a short knife sheath, bare feet. Hands and objects: a clay drinking bowl in his right hand, raised, with a thin chip at the rim; a coil of air-line over his left shoulder. Power: a deep blue-white shimmer of water qi rises from the drips on his shoulders like steam, and the water in the bowl glints like a pearl. Background: a bright lake, a boat, a white hot sky, wet dark planks. Light: bright hard noon from the upper left, water glitter, a pale silver rim around his shoulders. Expression: a lazy, easy, dangerous grin with the green-grey eyes half-lidded, a brave, callous man who does not mean to hurry.

people.imagined: The breeding pen at dawn. A fry brushes her palm, and she hums the same tune she hums every day. A fish scale is stuck to her sleeve, bright as a coin.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the edge of a shallow breeding pen at dawn, she holds one wet palm flat in the water and hums, looking down. Face: most important, the scale on her sleeve: a single large iridescent silver-green fish scale, the size of a coin, stuck on her left sleeve and catching the light, held in the foreground. A soft, oval, pale face of about thirty-one, long dark lashes, down-turned gentle dark eyes, thin brows, a small nose, a small mouth caught mid-hum, a freckle on the chin; a few damp strands cling to her cheek. Hair: dark brown, loosely tied at the neck with a thread and a pearl-shell pin, long strands falling forward. Body: slight, bent forward, relaxed. Clothing: layered moon-white silk robes with crossed collars of evening blue and wide pearl-grey gauze sleeves damp to the elbow, silver fish and ripples embroidered on the cuffs, an evening-blue sash tied loosely, a string of tiny silver fish-scale charms on the wrist. Hands and objects: her right hand flat under the water; a small silver fish with a blue stripe nosing her palm; a shell bowl of feed beside her knee. Power: soft silvery-blue water qi spreads in a ring of glowing ripples from her wrist, and a few pale motes rise from the fish. Background: a wooden pen, green-grey water, a pale pink dawn and drifting mist. Light: soft pink-white dawn from the upper left, a pearly rim on her cheek. Expression: a peaceful, tender softness, lips just parted on the hum.

people.imagined: The outer gate. He holds his right hand, dry and plain, in his sleeve, and the left hand open. He wrote twice to take his sister's place; his mother tore the second letter. The wrath is quiet.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the outer gate, arms folded so that one hand disappears inside the opposite sleeve, he glares at the viewer. Face: most important, the hidden hand: the right hand drawn deep into the left sleeve with only the cuff and knuckle edge visible, and the left hand held open and bare, showing no frost. A lean, hard, handsome young face of twenty-two with a strong jaw, angry dark eyes with a stubborn stare, thick straight brows drawn down, a straight nose, lips pressed to a line, a muscle in the cheek, a vein at the temple and slightly flared nostrils. Hair: black, tied up tight with a plain blue band, no pearl. Body: lean, upright and stiff, arms folded. Clothing: the plain, graceful silk of an outer disciple: moon-white robes with crossed pale blue collars and wide sleeves, a short pearl-grey gauze vest, collars embroidered in thin silver with moon ripples, an evening-blue sash, a grey sealskin vest, a wooden practice blade at his belt. Hands and objects: the sleeve-hidden hand; the open bare left hand. Power: none in his hands, only a faint thin blue thread of water qi curling at his collar like a held breath. Background: a weathered wooden gate with a pale lake beyond, low reeds bending, a grey sky with drifting mist. Light: cool pale light from the upper left, a faint silver rim on his jaw. Expression: a quiet, restrained fury, the jaw tight and the dark eyes hard and level, an ambitious young man who has swallowed his anger.

people.imagined: The north beds, just surfaced, eyes red-rimmed from salt. She saw skiffs sit on the water and not come in, and she tells it plainly. The fur cuffs are her herder's grandmother's.
people.subject: The moment: bobbing at the surface beside a boat's gunwale, she hauls herself half out and looks straight at the viewer. Face: most important, the red-rimmed eyes and fur cuffs: both eyes ringed bright red from salt, and thick white reindeer-fur cuffs on her forearms resting on the gunwale, one with a dark wet tide-line two fingers wide near the wrist. A blunt, strong, tanned face of twenty, wet black brows, stubborn dark eyes, a short nose, a firm mouth, salt crystals on the lashes, a faint flush. Hair: black, plastered wet to the head, a single thick braid streaming over her shoulder. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, solid; her wet shoulders broad and rounded, her neck short, water streaming off her chin in a thin line. Clothing: the close-fitting sea-grey silk of a diver with a stand collar, a short sleeveless pearl-grey gauze jacket, a soaked evening-blue sash, the white reindeer-fur cuffs, a cord of white shell beads at the neck. Hands and objects: both forearms laid on the boat's edge; a basket of oysters beside her and a string of small oyster shells on the gunwale. Power: a cold blue water qi shimmers on her wet shoulders, and the droplets on her lashes catch small white sparks. Background: a grey lake, mist, the pale shape of a distant skiff. Light: cold white light from the upper left, small white highlights on the wet fur. Expression: a direct stare with red-rimmed eyes, a firm mouth and an impatient jut of the chin, water running down her cheeks.

people.imagined: The old town's shallows at night, his pockets full of shells that click at every step. He tips a handful of oyster spat into the dead water as though planting a garden, and straightens, listening.
people.subject: The moment: standing knee-deep in dark shallows at night, he tips a cupped hand of tiny young oysters into the water, then straightens to listen. Face: most important, the pockets: both jacket pockets and the front of his coat bulge with grey oyster shells, spilling a few at the edge. A broad, kind, stubborn face of about thirty-one, calm dark eyes, thick straight brows, a flat nose, a mouth set in a plain line, a tanned neck; water beads on his short beard and tired lines show at his eyes. Hair: thick dark brown, cropped close and damp. Body: stocky, broad, grounded. Clothing: the plain, clean silk of an inner disciple: a moon-white robe with evening-blue collars and a pearl-grey gauze over-robe tucked up at the hem and rolled above the knee, a grey sealskin coat with large pockets over it, silver ripple embroidery along the collar, an evening-blue sash, a shell-button collar. Hands and objects: a cupped palm holding tiny pale spat that glisten like seed pearls; a small shell lantern on a hook at his belt giving a pale glow. Power: a faint blue water qi gathers round his cupped hand and a pale earth-yellow thread runs through it, and the spat gleam as they fall. Background: black shallows and the ruined outline of a drowned stone wall, a dim moon. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left, a pearly glimmer low on the water. Expression: a plain, quiet attentiveness with the head tilted and the mouth set, a man listening for the dead water to answer.

people.imagined: The net-drying yard, a joke just told. He is laughing loudest, a beat after everyone else, with the netting needle still behind his ear and a half-mended net in his lap.
people.subject: The moment: seated on an overturned boat with a net across his knees, he throws his head back and laughs a beat late, mouth wide open. Face: most important, the open laugh and the needle: a big open-mouthed laugh showing all his teeth, and a long pale bone net-needle tucked behind his right ear, sticking out, large in the frame. A round, freckled, open face of sixteen with chubby cheeks, narrow eyes screwed up with mirth, bushy brown brows, a flat wide nose, a gap in the front teeth, a dab of tar on the chin. Hair: dark brown, thick and untidy, with a dried leaf stuck in it. Body: plump, loose, shoulders shaking, bare ankles crossed beneath the hull. Clothing: the plain, tidy robes of an outer disciple: a moon-white silk shirt with sleeves rolled above the elbow, a loose pearl-grey gauze vest unlaced, a pale blue crossed collar embroidered with thin silver ripples, an evening-blue sash, bare feet. Hands and objects: a big tangle of grey netting on his lap with a few open meshes; one hand slapping his knee. Power: the damp nets hang glowing faintly silver and a few motes of pale blue water qi drift off his laughing shoulders. Background: a yard of drying nets hanging like curtains, a pale pearl sky. Light: bright soft cloudy daylight from the upper left, a pale highlight rimming the bone needle and the knuckles of his slapping hand. Expression: a gleeful, helpless, late laugh with the eyes screwed shut, a boy who laughs loudest a beat after everyone else.

people.imagined: The boat at the north beds. She turns a coin over and over in her palm, calm, and hands the pearls up as she should; a black pearl in her first year paid her way. Now a steward pays her something else.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a boat she turns a copper coin over in her open palm, looking up at the viewer with a cool, level gaze. Face: most important, the coin: a bright round copper coin with a square hole, held flat on her palm in the foreground, glinting. A fine, oval face of eighteen, smooth pale skin with a pink flush on the cheeks, steady narrow dark eyes, thin brows, a small neat nose, a closed small faintly curled mouth; a drop of lake water hangs on one lash. Hair: black, wound into a tight coil at the nape with a small pearl-headed pin, a damp strand at the temple. Body: slender, straight, composed. Clothing: an inner disciple's graceful robes of moon-white silk with narrow sleeves, crossed evening-blue collars, a pearl-grey gauze over-robe, a short grey sealskin shawl, silver fish and ripples embroidered at the cuffs, an evening-blue sash tied neatly, a thin cord with a single black pearl at the throat. Hands and objects: the coin turning in her right hand; her left rests on the edge of a basket of pearl shells. Power: a thin blue shimmer of water qi lies on the lake behind her and the black pearl at her throat holds a small cold light. Background: a pale grey lake, mist, the dark wet side of a boat. Light: soft cool light from the upper left, a pale rim along her jaw. Expression: a cool, level, faintly curled look with calm eyes, a girl who has already decided whom she works for.

people.imagined: 410, founding the manor on piles over the still pool. A memorial portrait of the diver who said the moon in the lake is easier to catch: she looks up at the sky, a pearl-diver's mask pushed up on her brow.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, its edges darkened; she stands on a plank over still water, her face lifted toward the moon, a diver's shell mask pushed up on her brow. Face: most important, the upward gaze and the moon: her face tilted toward a pale full moon disc painted faintly in the upper left, its reflection in the water. A broad, plain, weathered woman's face of about forty-five, wide-set patient dark eyes, thick plain brows, a short broad nose, a wide quiet gentle smile, salt lines at the eyes. Hair: black with grey, tied back with a cord and a plain pearl-shell pin, the carved shell mask pushed up on the forehead. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, solid. Clothing: the founder's dress as the old sect remembered her, simple and graceful: layered robes of moon-white silk with evening-blue crossed collars and a pearl-grey gauze over-robe, a plain sleeveless sea-grey vest over them in the diver's way, a rope belt, bare feet on the plank. Hands and objects: a small round oyster-shell dish held in the left hand; the right hand open, reaching up as if to catch the moon. Power: a pale blue-white shimmer of water qi surrounds her hand, softened by the fade, and fine motes of silver light float on the water. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a faint moon and still water. Light: soft pale light from the upper left, a dark vignette. Expression: a content, gentle gaze up at the moon, the lips softly curved.

people.imagined: 748, the frozen pool, the third month. A memorial portrait of the mistress who sat on the ice and kept the spirit fish alive: frost in her hair and lashes, a lotus pin of frost in her hair, her breath a plume.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the mistress, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, its edges darkened; she sits upright and cross-legged on a sheet of ice, still and silver with frost. Face: most important, the frost: her lashes, eyebrows and the strands of her hair coated in white rime, the whole face pale with a bluish cast, a small plume of breath at her lips. A strong, stern, handsome face of about forty-two with a firm jaw, closed or half-closed grey eyes, straight white-rimed brows, a straight nose, a closed mouth, skin silvery pale. Hair: black, heavily frosted white, gathered high in a coil held by a hairpin shaped like a frost lotus with five pale glassy petals, under a slender silver crown. Body: upright, still, broad-shouldered. Clothing: the robes of a mistress of the manor in an older style: layered moon-white silk with a high crossed evening-blue collar, a heavy pearl-grey gauze over-robe rimed with frost on the shoulders, silver fish and moon ripples embroidered at the hem, an old-style blue brocade sash, a few pearls at the ear. Hands and objects: both hands resting open on her knees above the ice; beneath the ice, faint dark fish shapes. Power: a strong pale blue-white mist of water qi and frost spreads from her over the ice, her breath rising like a plume, and tiny ice crystals glitter in the air. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a hint of a frozen pool. Light: cold pale light from the upper left, a dark vignette. Expression: a stern, unyielding stillness, the eyes lowered to the fish beneath her.
